retrievalProfile.description: A surreal photo-composite featuring a vibrant, oversized subject standing amidst a desaturated, high-contrast monochrome urban skyline.
triggerTerms: giant man in red suit over city

recipe.visualDefinition: A central, oversized male figure in a saturated red suit and yellow shirt stands with hands on hips and a guitar slung over his back, towering over a black-and-white aerial view of a dense skyscraper-filled city. The composition uses a sharp color-to-monochrome contrast to separate the subject from the background.
coreVisualRelationships: Central vertical alignment of the figure
Horizontal text placement at the top margin
coreInvariants: High-contrast color pop on the subject

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is centered and occupies approximately 60% of the vertical frame, appearing as a giant relative to the buildings.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The vibrant red suit acts as the primary visual anchor against the gray city.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the bright red subject, move up to the title text, then down into the detailed textures of the monochrome city.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is densely packed with architectural detail and the large subject.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Yellow and Sky Blue (shirt and guitar strap)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Extreme contrast between the 0% saturation background and 100% saturation subject.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family with varying weights or secondary decorative line elements.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the clean, vertical, 80s editorial feel.
Provides the necessary geometric clarity and spacing.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast black and white aerial photograph of a dense 1980s-era city skyline. Composite a giant man in a bright red suit, yellow shirt, and blue guitar strap standing in the middle of the city, towering over skyscrapers.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add uppercase condensed sans-serif text in salmon pink at the top center. Include a thin horizontal line with small circular nodes below the main title.

verificationChecks: Is the subject's suit a vibrant, saturated red?
Is the text centered and condensed?
Is the scale of the person clearly 'giant' compared to the buildings?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
Exact building configurations to avoid copyright
Specific brand logos on the guitar

mustAchieve: Sharp separation between color subject and gray background
Grainy film texture consistent with 1980s photography
avoid: Blurry edges on the subject cutout

postGenerationChecks: Check for clean masking around the subject's hair and guitar.
Ensure the text color does not vibrate too harshly against the sky.
Verify the 'giant' scale is maintained through perspective.
Confirm the background is fully desaturated.
recipe.reuseFormula: Giant [Subject] in [Vibrant Color] standing over [Monochrome Environment] with [Condensed Sans-Serif] header.
